reason: The README describes a monitoring plugin that calculates token costs, displays session spending, and retrieves account balance data in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示每轮与累计 Token 花费、估算人民币金额和账户余额。
summaries.en: Displays per-message and session token costs, estimated CNY amounts, and account balance in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Displays per-message and session token costs in the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Requests account balance data from the DeepSeek balance API using a host-held API key
Refreshes USD/CNY reference rates from public market-rate sources
Reads request usage data and pricing rules to calculate estimated costs
